title: 超市购物
purpose: 找商品、比较价格、结账和退换

lines.en: Excuse me, where can I find the milk?
lines.zh: 打扰一下，牛奶在哪里？

lines.en: It's in the dairy section, aisle six, next to the cheese.
lines.zh: 在乳制品区，六号通道，奶酪旁边。

lines.en: Thanks. And which aisle is the toothpaste in?
lines.zh: 谢谢。牙膏在哪个通道？

lines.en: Toiletries are in aisle ten, at the back of the shop.
lines.zh: 洗漱用品在十号通道，商店后面。

lines.en: Great. Do you sell phone chargers too?
lines.zh: 太好了。你们也卖手机充电器吗？

lines.en: Yes, but only a few. They're near the checkouts.
lines.zh: 卖，不过不多，在收银台附近。

lines.en: Perfect. One more thing: do you have a basket?
lines.zh: 太好了。还有一件事：有购物篮吗？

lines.en: Yes, the baskets are by the entrance.
lines.zh: 有，购物篮在入口旁边。

lines.en: Thank you for your help.
lines.zh: 谢谢你的帮助。

lines.en: No problem. Enjoy your shopping!
lines.zh: 不客气。购物愉快！

lines.en: Excuse me, I'm looking for this cereal, but the shelf is empty.
lines.zh: 打扰一下，我在找这种麦片，但货架空了。

lines.en: Let me check. I'm afraid it's out of stock today.
lines.zh: 我查一下。恐怕今天缺货了。

lines.en: Oh no. When will you have more?
lines.zh: 哦不。什么时候会再有货？

lines.en: We get a delivery every Tuesday, so probably tomorrow.
lines.zh: 我们每周二进货，所以应该明天有。

lines.en: OK. Is there anything similar?
lines.zh: 好的。有类似的吗？

lines.en: This brand is very similar, and it's on offer this week.
lines.zh: 这个牌子很像，而且本周在打折。

lines.en: Is it sweet? I don't like cereal with too much sugar.
lines.zh: 甜吗？我不喜欢太甜的麦片。

lines.en: It's less sweet than the other one. Look, it says "low sugar".
lines.zh: 比那个少甜一些。你看，上面写着"低糖"。

lines.en: Great, I'll try it. Thanks!
lines.zh: 太好了，我试试。谢谢！

words.e: OK. It printed a price tag. Do I stick it on the bag?
words.c: 好的。打出了一张价签。我把它贴在袋子上吗？

words.e: Oh, you're right! Then two small packs cost two pounds. That's a bargain!
words.c: 哦，你说得对！那两小包才两英镑，太便宜了！

words.e: These pens are cheap but good.
words.c: 这些笔又便宜又好用。

words.e: This cheese is too expensive.
words.c: 这个奶酪太贵了。

words.e: Is this on offer?
words.c: 这个在促销吗？

words.e: But look, this yellow label says "buy one get one free" on the small pack.
words.c: 但是你看，小包上的黄色标签写着"买一送一"。

words.e: Students get a ten per cent discount.
words.c: 学生可以打九折。

words.e: All the cakes are half price after six.
words.c: 六点以后所有蛋糕半价。

words.e: Do I need a loyalty card for this price?
words.c: 这个价格需要会员卡吗？

words.e: You get points every time you use your loyalty card.
words.c: 每次使用会员卡都能获得积分。

words.e: They're two pounds per kilo.
words.c: 每公斤两英镑。

words.e: Do I weigh them myself?
words.c: 要我自己称吗？

words.e: OK. It printed a price tag. Do I stick it on the bag?
words.c: 好的。打出了一张价签。我把它贴在袋子上吗？

words.e: Great. What does "best before" mean on the pack?
words.c: 太好了。包装上的"best before"是什么意思？

words.e: Are these organic?
words.c: 这些是有机的吗？

words.e: Kate, which one is better value, the big pack or the small pack?
words.c: 凯特，哪个更划算，大包还是小包？

words.e: Let's compare. The big one is three pounds for one kilo.
words.c: 我们比较一下。大包一公斤三英镑。

words.e: Kate, which one is better value, the big pack or the small pack?
words.c: 凯特，哪个更划算，大包还是小包？

words.e: Oh, you're right! Then two small packs cost two pounds. That's a bargain!
words.c: 哦，你说得对！那两小包才两英镑，太便宜了！

words.e: You can save money if you buy the big pack.
words.c: 买大包装可以省钱。

words.e: It's a bit expensive, but it's worth it.
words.c: 有点贵，但很值得。

lines.en: Kate, which one is better value, the big pack or the small pack?
lines.zh: 凯特，哪个更划算，大包还是小包？

lines.en: Let's compare. The big one is three pounds for one kilo.
lines.zh: 我们比较一下。大包一公斤三英镑。

lines.en: And the small one is two pounds for five hundred grams.
lines.zh: 小包五百克两英镑。

lines.en: So the big pack is better value.
lines.zh: 所以大包更划算。

lines.en: But look, this yellow label says "buy one get one free" on the small pack.
lines.zh: 但是你看，小包上的黄色标签写着"买一送一"。

lines.en: Oh, you're right! Then two small packs cost two pounds. That's a bargain!
lines.zh: 哦，你说得对！那两小包才两英镑，太便宜了！

lines.en: Great. What does "best before" mean on the pack?
lines.zh: 太好了。包装上的"best before"是什么意思？

lines.en: It means it's best to eat it before that date.
lines.zh: 意思是最好在那个日期之前吃。

lines.en: It says the fifth of next month, so that's fine.
lines.zh: 上面写着下个月五号，那没问题。

lines.en: Perfect. Let's take them.
lines.zh: 太好了，我们拿这个。

lines.en: Excuse me, how much are these apples?
lines.zh: 打扰一下，这些苹果多少钱？

lines.en: They're two pounds per kilo.
lines.zh: 每公斤两英镑。

lines.en: Do I weigh them myself?
lines.zh: 要我自己称吗？

lines.en: Yes, put them on the scale over there and press the apple button.
lines.zh: 是的，放到那边的秤上，按苹果的按钮。

lines.en: OK. It printed a price tag. Do I stick it on the bag?
lines.zh: 好的。打出了一张价签。我把它贴在袋子上吗？

lines.en: That's right.
lines.zh: 对。

lines.en: Are these organic?
lines.zh: 这些是有机的吗？

lines.en: No, the organic ones are on the left. They cost a bit more.
lines.zh: 不是，有机的在左边，贵一点。

lines.en: I'll take these, then. Thanks!
lines.zh: 那我就要这些吧。谢谢！

lines.en: You're welcome.
lines.zh: 不客气。

words.e: There's a long queue at the checkout.
words.c: 收银台排着长队。

words.e: The self-checkout is faster.
words.c: 自助结账更快。

words.e: The cashier gave me my change.
words.c: 收银员把零钱找给了我。

words.e: Excuse me, could you help me? The machine won't scan this.
words.c: 打扰一下，你能帮帮我吗？机器扫不上这个。

words.e: Sure. Let me try. ... The barcode is a bit wet. There, it's done.
words.c: 好的，我试试。……条形码有点湿。好了，扫上了。

words.e: That's because your own bag is on the scale. I'll fix it.
words.c: 那是因为你自己的袋子放在秤上了。我来处理。

words.e: Remember to bring your own bag to save money.
words.c: 记得自带购物袋，可以省钱。

words.e: Yes. Just tap your card on the card machine.
words.c: 可以。把卡在刷卡机上碰一下就行。

words.e: Please enter your PIN.
words.c: 请输入密码。

words.e: Insert your card into the machine.
words.c: 把卡插进机器里。

words.e: Yes. Just tap your card on the card machine.
words.c: 可以。把卡在刷卡机上碰一下就行。

words.e: Done! Do I need the receipt?
words.c: 好了！我需要收据吗？

words.e: It's a good idea to keep it, in case you need to return something.
words.c: 最好留着，万一要退东西。

words.e: Would you like an exchange or a refund?
words.c: 你想换货还是退款？

words.e: Would you like an exchange or a refund?
words.c: 你想换货还是退款？

words.e: Hi. I'd like to return these headphones. They're faulty.
words.c: 你好。我想退这副耳机，它有质量问题。

words.e: The card machine is broken, so please pay in cash.
words.c: 刷卡机坏了，请用现金付款。

words.e: Thanks. Now it says "unexpected item in the bagging area".
words.c: 谢谢。现在显示"装袋区有意外物品"。

words.e: The machine needs approval from a member of staff.
words.c: 机器需要工作人员确认。

words.e: There's an age check for some items, like knives.
words.c: 有些商品需要核查年龄，比如刀具。

words.e: Please join the queue here.
words.c: 请在这里排队。

patterns.en: No, thanks. I've got my own bag.
patterns.zh: 不用了，谢谢，我自己带了袋子。

patterns.en: The machine says "unexpected item in the bagging area".
patterns.zh: 机器显示"装袋区有意外物品"。

patterns.en: Excuse me, could you help me? It won't scan.
patterns.zh: 打扰一下，你能帮帮我吗？扫不上。

lines.en: Excuse me, could you help me? The machine won't scan this.
lines.zh: 打扰一下，你能帮帮我吗？机器扫不上这个。

lines.en: Sure. Let me try. ... The barcode is a bit wet. There, it's done.
lines.zh: 好的，我试试。……条形码有点湿。好了，扫上了。

lines.en: Thanks. Now it says "unexpected item in the bagging area".
lines.zh: 谢谢。现在显示"装袋区有意外物品"。

lines.en: That's because your own bag is on the scale. I'll fix it.
lines.zh: 那是因为你自己的袋子放在秤上了。我来处理。

lines.en: Sorry, I didn't know.
lines.zh: 抱歉，我不知道。

lines.en: No problem. It happens a lot. Now you can pay.
lines.zh: 没关系，经常这样。现在可以付款了。

lines.en: Can I pay by card here?
lines.zh: 这里可以刷卡吗？

lines.en: Yes. Just tap your card on the card machine.
lines.zh: 可以。把卡在刷卡机上碰一下就行。

lines.en: Done! Do I need the receipt?
lines.zh: 好了！我需要收据吗？

lines.en: It's a good idea to keep it, in case you need to return something.
lines.zh: 最好留着，万一要退东西。

lines.en: OK. Thanks for your help!
lines.zh: 好的。谢谢你的帮助！

lines.en: Hello. How can I help you?
lines.zh: 你好。有什么可以帮你的？

lines.en: Hi. I'd like to return these headphones. They're faulty.
lines.zh: 你好。我想退这副耳机，它有质量问题。

lines.en: I'm sorry about that. What's wrong with them?
lines.zh: 很抱歉。有什么问题？

lines.en: The left side doesn't work.
lines.zh: 左边没有声音。

lines.en: Do you have the receipt?
lines.zh: 你有收据吗？

lines.en: Yes, here it is. I bought them last Saturday.
lines.zh: 有，在这儿。我上周六买的。

lines.en: Would you like an exchange or a refund?
lines.zh: 你想换货还是退款？

lines.en: Can I get a refund, please?
lines.zh: 请问我可以退款吗？

lines.en: Sure. The money will go back to your card in three to five days.
lines.zh: 可以。钱会在三到五天内退回你的卡上。

lines.en: Great. Thank you!
lines.zh: 太好了。谢谢！
